title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain College of Charleston
description: A guide to the essential late-night food stops for College of Charleston students, focusing on under-21-safe spots near campus that stay open for post-study or weekend cravings.

cards.title: Benny Ravello's
cards.subtitle: Giant Slices on Upper King
cards.notes: Grab a massive 28-inch pizza slice at this Upper King staple. It is a go-to for students needing a quick, affordable late-night bite before heading back to the dorms.
cards.short_summary: A popular pizza shop on King Street known for its oversized slices and late-night service.
cards.evidence_claim: Benny Ravello's is open until 1:00 AM Sunday through Wednesday and until 2:00 AM Thursday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 2 AM on weekends; counter service is fast and under-21 friendly.

cards.title: Gilroy's Pizza Pub
cards.subtitle: Late-Night King Street Classic
cards.notes: Visit Charleston's oldest pizza joint for greasy, reliable slices. It has served the college crowd for decades and stays open later than almost anywhere else downtown.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing pizza pub on King Street famous for its very late operating hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Gilroy's Pizza Pub is open until 3:00 AM Sunday through Thursday and until 4:00 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Late-Night Eats: Charleston - South Carolina Tourism
cards.access_notes: Open until 4 AM on weekends; strictly a food-focused run for students after hours.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: Warm Cookies on King Street
cards.notes: Stop by for warm, fresh-baked cookies or ice cream sandwiches. This spot is a favorite for late-night study breaks and sweet cravings near the campus core.
cards.short_summary: A bakery chain specializing in late-night cookie delivery and walk-up service.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies at 509 King St offers late-night hours, typically serving until 1:00 AM or later.
cards.access_notes: Open late for walk-ins and delivery; perfect for dorm-room snacking.

cards.title: City Bistro
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Late-Night Dining
cards.notes: Head to Berry Hall for an all-you-care-to-eat late-night snack. It is the primary on-campus option for students using meal taps after standard dining hours.
cards.short_summary: The College of Charleston's bistro-style dining hall located in Berry Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus dining locations like City Bistro serve students until 10:00 PM daily and until midnight on weekends.
cards.access_notes: Accepts Meal Taps and Cougar Cash; open until midnight on Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: The Market at Berry Hall
cards.subtitle: Campus Convenience Store
cards.notes: Pick up microwavable meals, fresh fruit, or grab-and-go snacks. This on-campus market is the reliable stop for dorm essentials and late-night fuel.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus convenience store providing snacks and meals for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Market carries late-night snacks and microwavable meals and is listed as a key campus dining location.
cards.access_notes: Located in Berry Hall; accepts Cougar Cash and Dining Dollars.

cards.title: Kaminsky's Dessert Cafe
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Sweets at the Market
cards.notes: Enjoy a slice of rotating cake or a signature milkshake in a cozy setting. It is a popular spot for students to wind down with dessert after a night out.
cards.short_summary: A well-known dessert cafe in the French Quarter offering a wide variety of treats.
cards.evidence_claim: Kaminsky's is open until 11:00 PM Sunday through Thursday and until 1:00 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Under-21 safe; often has a line on weekends due to its popularity for late-night treats.

cards.title: Waffle House
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Breakfast Run
cards.notes: Visit this classic 24-hour diner for hashbrowns and waffles. While a short drive or ride from campus, it remains a quintessential late-night destination for students.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour breakfast chain restaurant located near the downtown area.
cards.evidence_claim: Waffle House locations in Charleston are generally open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7; always available for late-night dining regardless of the day.

cards.title: McDonald's
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Drive-Thru
cards.notes: Stop by the Spring Street location for a quick late-night meal. It is one of the few fast-food options near campus with extended hours on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A fast-food restaurant on Spring Street offering late-night and 24-hour service.
cards.evidence_claim: The McDonald's at 230 Spring St is open 24 hours on Friday and Saturday, and until midnight on other days.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru and lobby hours vary; 24-hour service available on weekends.

cards.title: Callie's Hot Little Biscuit
cards.subtitle: Weekend Late-Night Biscuits
cards.notes: Grab a savory or sweet biscuit at this Upper King window. It is a unique Charleston tradition that opens specifically for the late-night weekend crowd.
cards.short_summary: A famous biscuit shop that offers late-night service on Friday and Saturday nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Callie's Hot Little Biscuit on King St offers late-night service from 10:00 PM to 2:00 AM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: Guilty Pleasure: Callie's Hot Little Biscuit
cards.access_notes: Late-night hours are exclusive to Friday and Saturday nights; walk-up window service.

cards.title: The Rarebit
cards.subtitle: Retro Diner Comfort Food
cards.notes: Enjoy breakfast for dinner or a patty melt in this vintage-style diner. It is a more sit-down late-night option for students looking for comfort food on King Street.
cards.short_summary: A retro-themed diner on Upper King Street known for its late-night comfort food.
cards.evidence_claim: The Rarebit is open until 1:00 AM on Fridays and Saturdays, serving a full menu of comfort classics.
cards.access_notes: Under-21 safe for dining; kitchen serves the full menu until closing on weekends.
